envelope.description: Let the correction turn state a second failure

body.title: Let the correction turn state a second failure
body.summary: First capture the pre-change correction turn text for an INV-7 failure, with and without a prior failure, as a fixture, before the signature is changed. Then add the optional alsoFailing parameter to appendCorrectionTurn: after the primary failure and its hint, render the INV-13 failure and ask for both to be fixed. Without it the text is unchanged. The repetition banner keeps comparing the primary failure only.
acceptanceChecks: the pre-change fixture was captured before the signature change, and without alsoFailing the turn is byte-identical to it
with alsoFailing the primary comes first and the count second
a count that was a secondary note and then becomes the primary failure gets no repetition banner; a primary INV-13 repeated on the next attempt still does

tests.name: src/analyze/planner/__tests__/driver-unit.test.ts: appendCorrectionTurn without alsoFailing is byte-identical to the pre-change fixture
src/analyze/planner/__tests__/driver-unit.test.ts: appendCorrectionTurn with alsoFailing states the primary first and the count second
src/analyze/planner/__tests__/driver-unit.test.ts: repetition banner follows primary failures only, including the secondary-to-primary transition
